outcome.verified_behavior: All seven branch-taking Control tools now describe the short-name requirement. The test checks this guidance through the live MCP tools/list schema, while the earlier regression test verifies qualified refs are rejected before Git is invoked.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The schema and input boundary are verified. This does not measure whether agents notice the description, whether future live operations avoid the error, or whether the historical push command was recorded exactly.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A fully qualified local branch name makes a normal main push ambiguous
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Git branch and ref handling in the MNCS workspace
pressure_hypothesis.basis: This is interface verification for the previously recorded push-ref observation, not a separate agent encounter. A controlled fixture and the Control regression test establish the qualified-input case while leaving the historical command attribution unresolved.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use short branch names at branch operation boundaries; inspect later live use before assessing recurrence or effectiveness.
